actions.createContact.description: Create a new contact in Oncehub. Either email or mobile_phone is required.
actions.createContact.props.email.descri: Email address of the contact (at least email or mobile_phone required)
actions.createContact.props.mobile_phone: Mobile phone number in E.164 format (at least email or mobile_phone required)
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.findContact.description: Search for contacts in Oncehub by various criteria
description: Build meaningful on-brand scheduling experiences with OnceHubs online appointment booking software
triggers.bookingCanceled.description: Triggered when User or Customer cancels a booking
Triggered when Customer cancels a booking and then reschedules on a different booking page.
triggers.bookingCompleted.description: Triggered when booking end time has passed.
triggers.bookingNoshow.description: Triggered when User sets the completed booking to No-show
triggers.bookingRescheduled.description: Triggered when Customer reschedules a booking on the same booking page and Customer reschedules a booking following a request from the User to reschedule
triggers.bookingScheduled.description: Triggered when Customer schedules a booking and when User approves a booking requested by a Customer
triggers.conversationAbandoned.descripti: Triggered when website visitor stops interacting with a bot for more than 10 minutes.
triggers.conversationClosed.description: Triggered when: Website visitor reaches the end of the conversation flow and when Website visitor starts a new conversation with a different chatbot
triggers.conversationStarted.description: Triggered when website visitor starts interacting with a chatbot.
